title: time-block-interview-pilot-scratchpad-rosie
body:
Purpose: personal prep for EM 1:1s, weekly HC sync, and a short pilot to compress interview scheduling windows. Notes are rough; intended to be pared down into a short playbook if pilot shows signal. Share subset with Marco and Priya only.

Quick snapshot (confirm with ATS before sync):
- Total open reqs (eng + product): 31
- Candidates past phone screen: 64
- Offers accepted (30d): 5
- Rolling accept rate (90d): ~62%
- Median time-to-offer: 33 days
- Interview no-show trend: 7% last 30d
- Avg interviews per interviewer/week: 5.1

Objective for pilot:
- Reduce calendar friction, shorten loop time, and centralize debriefs. Target: 15% reduction in time-to-offer over 4 weeks; 25% reduction in no-shows.

Proposed time-block model (differentiator: small windows + strict debrief SLA):
- Window pattern: Mon mornings (AM) + Wed afternoons (PM) for cross-functional roles; Tue AM + Thu AM for core infra/backend.
- Each window capped at 3 panels sequentially (no more than 3 x 45m blocks per interviewer).
- Candidate flow: phone screen -> block window 1 (technical) -> block window 2 (culture/leadership).
- Booking rule: invite candidate to 2 preferred windows; if declines, escalate to flexible scheduling.

Debiasing steps built-in:
- Rotate at least one external interviewer into each window (different team).
- Use a 5-field scoring card (competency, communication, problem decomposition, collaboration, ramp potential).
- Quick calibration: 15m pre-window huddle on sample scoring examples.

Suggested interview loop edits (short checklist):
- Phone screen (25m): standard pass criteria + red flags list.
- Technical (45m): single focused task or design prompt; interviewer enters notes inside 6h.
- Culture/Impact (30-40m): specific cross-team collaboration example required.
- Debrief (20m): same-day group debrief; fill one-line verdict + top risk.
- Decision SLA: hiring manager submits proposed outcome and comp recommendation within 48h of final loop.

Short debrief template (1 line fields to paste into ATS):
- Candidate: <name> | Role: <req id> | Verdict: <Hire/Consider/Pass> | Top strength: <phrase> | Top risk: <phrase> | Confidence(1-5): <n> | Rec comp band: <band>

Agenda notes for EM 1:1s (10-12 min each):
1) 60s req priorities: which single hire moves your roadmap most in next 6 weeks?
2) Interviewer capacity: any folks we should pause or rotate off panels?
3) Pilot ask: can you commit 1-2 panelists to fixed weekly windows for 4 weeks?
4) Comp approvals: any expected exceptions? how fast can you sign?
5) Close: blockers for hiring coordinators and any tech / infra constraints.

Action items and owners (short):
- Marco: create shared calendar blocks and auto-reminder template; set up recurring 15m "pre-window" calibration (due 2025-11-13).
- Priya: confirm negotiable comp ceiling per level and update approver list (due 2025-11-08).
- Rosie: build a Google Sheet pilot dashboard (time-to-offer, no-show, accept rate) and share in headcount sync (due 2025-11-12).
- Hiring Ops: add tag "time-block" to ATS and configure 48h/24h reminders (due 2025-11-09).
- EMs: pick two priority hires to include in pilot per function (discuss in next HC sync).

Risk notes and mitigations:
- Time zone mismatch: allow one "out-of-window" slot per candidate; track as exception.
- Interview fatigue: limit to 2 windows/person/week + mandatory 10m buffer between interviews.
- Quality vs speed tradeoff: preserve calibration and enforce note submission SLA.

Open questions to surface at hiring council:
- Are take-homes reducing onsite loops or just delaying decisions? trial short role-specific tasks for 2 roles.
- Should referrals skip initial block and go direct to technical window? define clear criteria.
- Fast-track triggers: ex-Redwood alumni, high-impact referrals, or senior hires — what cadence should we use?

Candidate experience improvements (quick wins):
- Send single PDF with interview schedule + interviewer names + one-line role expectations 48h prior.
- Post-interview: hiring manager blurb within 72h; recruiting follow-up within 24h.

Pre-sync checklist (what I will bring to weekly headcount sync):
- Prioritized req snapshot (highlight top 4).
- Pilot dashboard draft (spreadsheet view).
- List of EM commitments and any comp exceptions.

Links / references (for quick copy into sync):
- Playbook draft (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=CONFLUENCE-54012
- Pilot epic (Jira): JIRA-HIRE-1023
- Slack pilot thread: slack://channel/people-ops-scheduling
- Debrief template PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/hr-scripts/pull/58

Final notes to self:
- Keep pilot intentionally narrow: two functions, four roles each, four weeks.
- Emphasize data collection over perfection; aim to iterate fast.
- Schedule a retro 1 week after pilot ends to capture learnings.
